versions.changelog:
Initial release: Skill for analyzing Chinese blog posts for AI writing style signals and generating concise stance-based comments.

- Analyzes Chinese blog posts for features of AI-generated writing.
- Extracts main claims and argument structure from the original text.
- Generates a targeted support or oppose comment, up to 140 English characters.
- Includes detailed content eligibility checks to avoid political or high-risk topics.
- Adapts style and strictness based on text genre and context.
- Refuses to process content that is political, high-risk, or not suitable for analysis.
